sloka: रावणम् मैथिली तत्र पुनः न उवाच किंचन ।सीताया वचनम् श्रुत्वा परुषम् रोम हर्षणम् ॥३-५६-२३॥
transliteration: rāvaṇam maithilī tatra punaḥ na uvāca kiṁcana ।sītāyā vacanam śrutvā paruṣam roma harṣaṇam ॥3-56-23॥

translations.english: Having heard such harsh, horripilating words from Sita, Ravana replied in a way designed to create fear in her:
